title: Retractable hooks and garment rod wall mount 10-Inch solid brass pullout rod, Fresno Collection Allied Brass
short_title: Retractable hooks and garment rod 10-Inch wall mount
description:
Add space-saving hanging storage with a retractable hooks and garment rod designed to pull out when you need it and retract neatly when not in use. This wall mount pullout rod is crafted from solid brass and coordinates with the Fresno collection for a clean, disciplined look across modern bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Pullout rod extends to provide a handy place to hang garments or towels
- Retracts when not in use to help keep spaces streamlined
- Installs in an end wall or door frame with concealed screw mounting hardware
- Solid brass construction for enduring everyday use
- Available in a wide variety of designer finishes to match modern bathroom hardware

Specs:
- Projection/extension: 10-Inch
- Overall size: 10-Inch L x 2-Inch W x 1.9-Inch H
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Required wall depth to retract: 10 inches
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Includes: brass rod, rod housing, and installation hardware
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Style notes: Ideal for matching Fresno pieces and minimalist bathroom hardware in the bathroom, laundry area, or dressing area.
